description: Decide whether observable failure evidence justifies one profile-level escalation

decision.instructions: Decide from the supplied observable failure evidence only. Ordinary first errors and directly actionable failures stay. Uncertain cases stay.

criteria.stay: No escalation: the failure is ordinary, isolated, directly actionable, lacks repeated evidence, or the evidence is uncertain
criteria.escalate: Escalate one level: repeated unsuccessful edits, persistent tests with multiple plausible causes, unresolved ambiguity, inability to locate relevant code, or a newly exposed security or cross-component concern
